adopted: GCCのAVX2・64頂点以上・非負・有限範囲・距離onlyに限定。整数biasで順序を保った正規化binary64のビット列へ移し、整数加算とMINPDで更新。INF検出時は変換済みprefixを戻して旧kernelへ。追加全行列検査走査/heap領域/CPU判定は増やさない。
contract: GCC x86 AVX2、距離のみ・非負・FiniteRange・Finite enum dispatch・n>=64に限定。追加template bool EncodeEligibleはFiniteRange&&UseSimdの型がFloydWarshallSimdModeかどうかだけで決め、元Denseは追跡しない。Clangでは追加bool/引数/本体をpreprocessor除外し、SIMD無効時も全追加コードを除外。
encoding_proof: bias=0x3ff0000000000000。格納値0..INFとcandidate<=2*INFの整数加算後のraw bitsはbias..0x5ff0000000000000にあり、正のnormal finite binary64としてビット順と大小順が一致する。整数vector load→castpd→minpd→castsi storeで、double型のmemory aliasやFP加算/丸め変換を用いない。NaN/±0/subnormalを含まないためMINPDの例外的なtie/NaN規則、FTZ/DAZ、丸め方向に影響されない。
rollback_proof: encodeとINF検出を融合し、失敗した4lane batchは書かない。encoded_rowsは完全変換済み行、encoded_columnsは失敗行の変換済みprefix長を保持。失敗時はこのprefixだけunbiasして元kernelへ渡す。全finite時はcolumns=0へ戻して全n行をdecodeするのでrow[n]へ進まない。追加allocation/所有状態/配列検査専用走査なし。INF判定は入力検査ではなく実装選択でありSKIP時も保持。

from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,json,hashlib
p=Path(__file__).parent;r=Path('/home/reinsirk/Atcoder_Env');baseline=(p/'baseline.hpp').read_text();submission=(r/'Verify/current/submissions/floyd_warshall.cpp').read_text();assert submission.count(baseline)==1
sha=lambda b:hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest();rows=[]
for compiler in ['gcc','clang']:
 for native in [False,True]:
  binaries={};cmds=[]

   source=submission.replace(baseline,(p/(variant+'.hpp')).read_text());(p/'single_fixed.cpp').write_text(source)
   cmd=['taskset','-c','10','/usr/bin/g++'if compiler=='gcc'else'clang++','-std=c++23','-O2',str(p/'single_fixed.cpp'),'-o',str(p/'single_fixed')]
   if compiler=='clang':cmd+=['--gcc-install-dir=/usr/lib/gcc/x86_64-linux-gnu/15']

   q=subprocess.run(cmd,capture_output=True,text=True);assert q.returncode==0,q.stderr

  rows.append({'compiler':compiler,'native':native,'binaries_equal':binaries['baseline']==binaries['path_init'],'builds':cmds});print(compiler,native,rows[-1]['binaries_equal'],flush=True)

from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,json,hashlib,concurrent.futures,os
p=Path(__file__).parent;r=Path('/home/reinsirk/Atcoder_Env');tests=['floyd_simd_test.cpp','floyd_boundary_test.cpp','floyd_finite_range_test.cpp']
configs=[('path_init',test,skip,fallback,False)for test in tests for skip,fallback in [(False,False),(True,False),(False,True)]]
def run(conf):
 variant,test,skip,fallback,simdoff=conf;name=f'{variant}-{Path(test).stem}-s{int(skip)}f{int(fallback)}d{int(simdoff)}';exe=p/name
 cmd=['taskset','-c','16','/usr/bin/g++','-std=c++23','-O2','-Wall','-Wextra','-Wpedantic',f'-DFLOYD_SOURCE="{p/(variant+".hpp")}"',str(r/'Verify/current/tests'/test),'-o',str(exe)]
 if skip:cmd+=['-DSKIP_RUNTIME_CHECKS']
 if simdoff:cmd+=['-DSIRKIT_DISABLE_SIMD']
 if fallback:cmd+=['-U__SIZEOF_INT128__']
 q=subprocess.run(cmd,text=True,capture_output=True);row={'name':name,'variant':variant,'test':test,'skip':skip,'fallback':fallback,'simdoff':simdoff,'source_sha256':hashlib.sha256((p/(variant+'.hpp')).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'test_sha256':hashlib.sha256((r/'Verify/current/tests'/test).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'compile_cmd':cmd,'compile_status':q.returncode,'compile_stderr':q.stderr}
 if q.returncode==0:
  q=subprocess.run(['taskset','-c','16',str(exe)],text=True,capture_output=True);row.update(run_status=q.returncode,stdout=q.stdout,stderr=q.stderr)
 print(name,row.get('run_status',row['compile_status']),flush=True)
 return row
with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=3)as pool:rows=list(pool.map(run,configs))
(p/'path-init-checks.json').write_text(json.dumps(rows,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n');print('PASS'if all(x.get('run_status')==0 for x in rows)else'FAIL')

from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,json,fcntl,hashlib
p=Path(__file__).parent;rows=[];lock=open('/tmp/sirkit_performance_cpu4.lock','w');fcntl.flock(lock,fcntl.LOCK_EX)
for compiler in ['gcc','clang']:
 for cfg in ['default','native']:
  for disabled in [False,True]:
   digests={}
   for name in ['baseline','encoded_dense_gcc']:
    # ソース/出力名も固定し、FILEシンボル等の差を除く。
    source=p/'dense-equiv-current.cpp';source.write_text((p/'equiv.cpp').read_text().replace('SIRKIT_FLOYD_TEST_SOURCE', '"'+str(p/(name+'.hpp'))+'"'))
    binary=p/'dense-equiv';cmd=['taskset','-c','4','/usr/bin/g++'if compiler=='gcc'else'clang++','-std=c++23','-O2','-DSKIP_RUNTIME_CHECKS']
    if compiler=='clang':cmd+=['--gcc-install-dir=/usr/lib/gcc/x86_64-linux-gnu/15']
    if cfg=='native':cmd+=['-march=native']
    if disabled:cmd+=['-DSIRKIT_DISABLE_SIMD']
    cmd += [str(source),'-o',str(binary)]
    q=subprocess.run(cmd,capture_output=True,text=True);assert q.returncode==0,q.stderr
    digest=hashlib.sha256(binary.read_bytes()).hexdigest();digests[name]=digest
    run=subprocess.run(['taskset','-c','4',str(binary)],capture_output=True,text=True);assert run.returncode==0,run.stderr
    rows.append(dict(compiler=compiler,cfg=cfg,disabled=disabled,variant=name,cmd=cmd,diagnostics=q.stderr,binary_sha256=digest,stdout=run.stdout,stderr=run.stderr))
   if compiler=='clang' or disabled:assert len(set(digests.values()))==1,(compiler,cfg,disabled,digests)
   print(compiler,cfg,disabled,'PASS',flush=True)
(p/'dense-equiv.json').write_text(json.dumps(rows,indent=2)+'\n')

from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,json,hashlib,concurrent.futures,os
p=Path(__file__).parent;r=Path('/home/reinsirk/Atcoder_Env');tests=['floyd_simd_test.cpp','floyd_boundary_test.cpp','floyd_finite_range_test.cpp']
configs=[('path_init',test,skip,fallback,False)for test in tests for skip,fallback in [(False,False),(True,False),(False,True)]]
def run(conf):
 variant,test,skip,fallback,simdoff=conf;name=f'{variant}-{Path(test).stem}-s{int(skip)}f{int(fallback)}d{int(simdoff)}';exe=p/name
 cmd=['taskset','-c','16','/usr/bin/g++','-std=c++23','-O2','-Wall','-Wextra','-Wpedantic',f'-DFLOYD_SOURCE="{p/(variant+".hpp")}"',str(r/'Verify/current/tests'/test),'-o',str(exe)]
 if skip:cmd+=['-DSKIP_RUNTIME_CHECKS']
 if simdoff:cmd+=['-DSIRKIT_DISABLE_SIMD']
 if fallback:cmd+=['-U__SIZEOF_INT128__']
 q=subprocess.run(cmd,text=True,capture_output=True);row={'name':name,'variant':variant,'test':test,'skip':skip,'fallback':fallback,'simdoff':simdoff,'source_sha256':hashlib.sha256((p/(variant+'.hpp')).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'test_sha256':hashlib.sha256((r/'Verify/current/tests'/test).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'compile_cmd':cmd,'compile_status':q.returncode,'compile_stderr':q.stderr}
 if q.returncode==0:
  q=subprocess.run(['taskset','-c','16',str(exe)],text=True,capture_output=True);row.update(run_status=q.returncode,stdout=q.stdout,stderr=q.stderr)
 print(name,row.get('run_status',row['compile_status']),flush=True)
 return row
with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=3)as pool:rows=list(pool.map(run,configs))
(p/'path-init-checks.json').write_text(json.dumps(rows,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n');print('PASS'if all(x.get('run_status')==0 for x in rows)else'FAIL')
